scientific_limitations: The exact Gamma moment and entropy identities are for one normalized anisotropic Gaussian family. No classification of arbitrary near-extremizers, global stability, reverse p<2 bound, or global entropy nonattainment is proved. The sharp p>2 upper inequality is credited to Dabra–Dasgupta–Gulia and Heisenberg Young nonattainment to Christ. Priority relative to potentially unindexed equivalent arguments remains uncertain.
title: Sharp Heisenberg short-time Fourier Lieb and entropy constants via an exact Gaussian contraction law
